rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 16 November 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 Hong Kong’s Legislative Council record shows that the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Ordinance was gazetted on 13 November after passage on 4 November. The record does not state commencement, scope, transition or reporting requirements, so management should obtain the enacted Gazette text before deciding applicability. Hong Kong 🟡 Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Ordinance gazetted 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261113-legco-crypto-asset-reporting-framework ⏰ Deadline: No source commencement or implementation deadline stated Products: Investment services, digital asset services The Legislative Council record states that the Bill passed on 4 November 2026, with Administration amendments, and that the resulting Ordinance was gazetted on 13 November 2026. This moves the matter from the bill process to a gazetted Ordinance. The record does not set out commencement, transitional arrangements, reporting dates, affected entities, thresholds, exemptions or operative requirements; it therefore does not establish a current duty for a particular bank, product or customer group. Tax and Legal should obtain the enacted Gazette text and assess commencement and applicability before any implementation decision; if applicable, relevant reporting and customer-data flows may need further assessment. Source: Legislative Council bill record Mainland/GBA No validated items in this run. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No validated benchmark items in this run.
